summary: Healthcare and safety auditing are critical for preventing harm and ensuring the responsible development of AI systems. SimpleAudit is a lightweight framework designed to support multilingual auditing and red-teaming of AI systems via adversarial probing. It operates in the context of healthcare, safety, and RAG (Reasoning, Argumentation, and Grounding) scenarios, with a focus on preventing harm and ensuring the responsible development of AI systems. The framework is particularly relevant to low- and middle-income countries, where access to healthcare and safety resources may be limited. By supporting multilingual testing and local model evaluation, SimpleAudit aims to improve the accessibility and effectiveness of AI safety auditing in diverse contexts.
